::: {#exr-bikeshare-weather}

#### The weather with the most rentals

The [`Bikeshare` data](#sec-bikeshare-lab) record the weather of each hour as `weathersit`,
and the number of bikes rented in that hour as `bikers`.
A [covariate](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) whose groups have very different [sample means](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of the [outcome](model-validation.qmd#def-outcome-vector) is a promising one for a regression model.

::: {.callout-tip}

#### Hint

`dplyr::group_by()` and `dplyr::summarise()` in R, `tapply()` in base R, and the `.groupby()` method of a pandas data frame in Python, compute a [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) within each group.

:::

Which value of `weathersit` has the largest [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of `bikers`?

:::
